opus.problem: Acts 18:2 does not say Aquila and Priscilla were tentmakers or that Paul stayed and worked with them. Those details are in Acts 18:3, so the clue is not true to its cited verse.
1 Corinthians 1:2 does not name Paul and Sosthenes as the writers. That detail is in 1 Corinthians 1:1, so the clue is not true to its cited verse.
